links.outcome: Resistance of federated model with differential privacy to inference and reconstruction attacks
links.effect: Privacy robustness tests reported strong resistance against inference and reconstruction attacks; no attack success rates given in the abstract.
links.quote: Moreover, privacy robustness tests confirm strong resistance against inference and reconstruction attacks.

unlisted_practices: Federated learning across institutions with differential privacy for training imaging AI without centralizing patient data
Adaptive aggregation strategies for non-IID data across institutions

screen.reason: Evaluates a proposed federated learning framework (FedIHRAS) combining imaging diagnostics and report generation across multiple datasets with expert radiologist validation of attention maps, but focuses on system/algorithm performance rather than testing a health care deployment practice.
